title: Pixtt Xxeric Kex
summary: Xxeric trades defense for aggression, summons ukun and heals into a final rage.
overview: Xxeric trades defense for aggression, summons ukun and heals into a final rage.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Reserve resources for the health recovery at 10% and keep ukun controlled through the middle stages.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: At 90%, the room seals and the cleaver timer begins; subsequent health bands shorten its interval.
At 70% she changes from flurry to area rampage.
At 50% she summons ukun and starts the rage timer. The hounds have limited scripted replacements when killed.
At 10% she casts a reset effect and restores her health to 40% for the final rage.

notes: Approval E332. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
